attributes.content: Food service supply for kitchens that never stop.

attributes.text: Restaurants, takeaways, caterers and fast food operators rely on us for consistent quality at trade prices, from basmati and ghee to frozen fish and packaging.

attributes.text: From curry houses in the Balti Triangle to event caterers feeding thousands, our food service customers need the same thing: the right stock, on time, every time.
Basmati, sella and long grain in catering sacks.
Whole and ground spices, blends and masalas.
Cooking oils, vegetable ghee and pure ghee.
Chapati flour, gram flour and more.
Fish, vegetables, breads and ready-to-cook lines.
Fast food packaging and kitchen essentials.
One person who knows your menu, your volumes and your delivery days.
The same spec, pack after pack, so your dishes taste the same every service.
We plan stock ahead of the busiest trading periods so you don’t run short.

attributes.content: We supply every part of the trade.

attributes.text: Bulk spices, pulses, nuts and flours supplied consistently to specification.
Retail-ready packs and white label options for independents and national retailers.
Pallet volumes and reliable stock for wholesalers and cash & carries nationwide.
Wholesale pricing, a named account manager and delivery across the UK and Europe.
